description: A contemporary minimalist bedroom vignette shot at seated eye-level with a normal lens, framed as an off-center thirds composition that captures the left nightstand side of the bed. A matte black electrical outlet plate is flush-mounted to the wall below the wall fixture. The bed features a tall tufted upholstered headboard in a soft cream linen with a deep button-tufted grid, dressed with crisp white and ecru pillows and sheets. At the lower left corner, the edge of a gray upholstered accent chair is barely visible. The floor shows dark-stained wide plank hardwood with a cream geometric diamond-weave textured area rug at the foot of the bed. The overall mood is moody, composed, and modern with a hotel-like precision.
